[← All session summaries](../sessions.qmd) · [← Previous: Session XI](session-11.qmd)

**Date:** November 25, 2026 at 15:39 UTC · **Presenter:** Ekoko Clesh (Mozambique) · **Type:** Hands-on Lab (1 hour 30 minutes)

## What we covered

- **AI Agent vs. Chat Assistant:** How coding agents inspect, plan, edit, run tools—far beyond simple Q&A
- **Why Large Codebases Are Hard:** Structure, history, boundaries, and evidence
- **Bad Prompts vs. Good Prompts:** Vague instructions fail; clear context succeeds
- **Four Essential Task Parts:** Goal, Context, Constraint, Done When
- **Repository Mapping:** Understanding entry points, components, data flow
- **agents.md Files:** Reusable project rules to avoid token waste
- **Six-Step Workflow:** Explore → Plan → Approve → Edit → Test → Review
- **Code Review Framework:** Four questions before accepting AI changes
- **Real Example:** Building a task manager web app from specification
- **SWE Bench Concept:** Real benchmarks for real programming tasks

## Key insight

> Passing tests ≠ code is ready. Test pass proves behavior; humans decide if change belongs in project.
